mythology: Sati's navel center (Nabhi kshetra) descended here; later Devi performed rigorous penance under a mango tree on the sands of Kampa river to unite with Lord Shiva.
pilgrimage_significance: Supreme seat of Sri Vidya upasana and abode of Sri Kanchi Kamakoti Peetham; one of the Sapta Mokshapuri pilgrimage cities.
historical_notes: Celebrated in ancient Tamil Sangam poetry, Lalita Sahasranama commentary, and Mukha Panchashati; Adi Shankara pacified the ferocious energy here with the Sri Chakra.
